title: Erratic g4 xdrip readings
symptom: Readings from the last 3 sensors have been very erratic, jumping from double down to double up constantly throughout the day. The last sensor had to be replaced after three days and the new one is doing the same again.
cause: Dehydration might be the issue, as the user has challenges getting his son to drink during the day at school. Also, poor connection to the sensor can cause this, but the user says they always check contacts.
fix: Ensure the sensor contacts are cleaned with an alcohol swab with every change, and check if the issue improves with increased fluid intake. If not, report the sensor as failed to the supplier without mentioning xDrip or xBridge.
evidence_quote: 1) Does this improve if he drinks some fluid?  Dehydration can cause this sort of thing (experience it myself all the time). 2) Do you make sure the G4 contacts are cleaned with an alcohol swab with every change?  Poor connection to the sensor can often cause this
